from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its bibliography references to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
